description: This file implements the MaximumPlayerConfigurationExplorer class and related functions for exploring maximum player configurations in a media testing context, including search algorithms for poset maximal elements and player instance management.

classes.name: MaximumPlayerConfigurationExplorer
classes.description: Class for exploring maximum player configurations based on resource constraints and test configurations.

classes.name: PlayerInstance
classes.description: Struct representing a player instance with associated DRM system and configuration.

methods.name: MaximumPlayerConfigurationExplorer::MaximumPlayerConfigurationExplorer
methods.description: Constructor initializing the explorer with player configs and resource limits.

methods.name: MaximumPlayerConfigurationExplorer::CalculateMaxTestConfigs
methods.description: Calculates and returns the maximum test configurations based on resource constraints.

methods.name: MaximumPlayerConfigurationExplorer::IsConfigCreatable
methods.description: Checks if a given configuration of player instances can be created within resource limits.

methods.name: MaximumPlayerConfigurationExplorer::CreatePlayerInstance
methods.description: Creates a new player instance with specified configuration.
